raw_content:
```yaml
rules:
- id: "vuln-java-merge-sort-450fdee7"
  pattern: |
    File.createTempFile($PREFIX, $SUFFIX)
  pattern-not: |
    Files.createTempFile($PREFIX, $SUFFIX).toFile()
  languages: ["java"]
  message: "Insecure temporary file creation detected. Use Files.createTempFile instead of File.createTempFile to avoid potential security vulnerabilities."
  severity: ERROR
  metadata:
    source-url: "github.com/cowtowncoder/java-merge-sort/commit/450fdee70b5f181c2afc5d817f293efa1a543902"
    category: security
    cwe: CWE-377
    owasp: A9
    references:
      - "https://owasp.org/www-community/vulnerabilities/Insecure_Temporary_File"
    technology: java
```
